operations.detail: Remote HEAD, same-owner lease, revision17 queue and five absent runtime outputs were revalidated.
The expired lease was renewed for the identical owner and session after confirming no competing owner; no takeover occurred.
Revision17 used subprocess.run without a timeout. Revision18 supervises every child with explicit hard and stall deadlines.
Long-running child stdout and stderr are redirected to files rather than captured pipes, preventing pipe-buffer deadlock and memory growth.
Every child has a fixed maximum runtime; hydration and checkpoint join are capped at 24 hours.
A child is terminated when cache bytes, SQLite bytes or expected output files show no progress within its stall window.
On Windows a timed-out child tree is terminated with taskkill /T /F, preventing orphan descendants.
On POSIX the supervised process group receives SIGTERM and then SIGKILL after the grace period.
Child logs are written to bounded files; only the final 12,000 bytes are embedded in watchdog reports.
Release cache directory growth and SQLite database/output growth count as progress during long hydration and join work.
The watchdog will publish current step, PID, elapsed time, last progress time and watched file sizes every 30 seconds.
Fast success, nonzero exit, timeout, progress-file activity, heartbeat, logging and safety behavior passed local preflight.
Missing steps, timeouts, nonzero exits, insufficient heartbeats, parallel child policy and safety flags fail closed.
All six revision18 scripts parse and the pipeline contains 18 serial supervised child steps with no shell invocation.
Eighteen watchdog, fourteen liveness acceptance and sixteen pipeline manifest tests passed local code preflight only.
The same task and attempt now target 73 effective steps, 530 tests and 74 official source checks without a new runner or replay.
The web layer exposes hard timeout, stall timeout, watched resources and pending status for each of 18 child steps.
Canonical runner pickup is still absent; no watchdog heartbeat, hydrated package, checkpoint join, candidate validation or business row is claimed.
The final 18th acceptance step now validates only the previous 17 completed steps instead of waiting for its own result.
Stdout and stderr remain visible but their growth no longer resets the progress timer; only watched cache, database or output changes count.
Watch directories are scanned one level deep rather than recursively every five seconds, reducing runner load during large downloads.
